Banks to observe 14 holidays in August across India

Banks across India will remain closed for 14 days in August, according to the Reserve Bank of India's (RBI) holiday calendar. These holidays include weekends and specific regional or national observances. Customers are advised to check the RBI list to plan their banking activities accordingly. The closures will affect services provided by major lenders like SBI and HDFC.
